"""Bounded guard tests; these fixture results are not maintained gate receipts."""

import hashlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import common


class GuardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
            prefix="lyxose-finalizer-tests-", dir="/private/tmp"
        )
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.original = self.root / "original.txt"
        self.original.write_bytes("β-L-lyxose\r\nretained\n\n".encode())

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def test_lossless_whitespace_unicode(self):
        result = common.wrapper(self.original)
        self.assertEqual(result["text"].encode(), self.original.read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(
            result["original"]["sha256"], hashlib.sha256(self.original.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        )
        self.assertTrue(result["text"].endswith("\n\n"))

    def test_changed_digest_rejected(self):
        binding = common.bind(self.original)
        self.original.write_bytes(b"changed")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            common.verify(binding)

    def test_wrong_size_rejected(self):
        binding = common.bind(self.original)
        binding["bytes"] += 1
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            common.verify(binding)

    def test_relative_escape_rejected(self):
        for path in ["/absolute", "../escape", "a/../escape", ".", ""]:
            with self.subTest(path=path), self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                common.relative(path)

    def test_new_output_protections(self):
        for path in [
            self.original,
            common.ROOT / "unexpected-finalizer-output",
            common.PACKAGE / "unexpected-finalizer-output",
            common.SCIENCE / "unexpected-finalizer-output",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(path=path), self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                common.external_new(path)
        self.assertEqual(common.external_new(self.root / "safe-new"), self.root / "safe-new")

    def test_maintained_mutation_without_apply_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            common.run("never-run", ["does-not-exist"], self.root, mutation=True, apply=False)
        self.assertEqual(list(self.root.iterdir()), [self.original])

    def test_write_is_append_only(self):
        dest = self.root / "append.json"
        common.write(dest, {"first": True})
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            common.write(dest, {"second": True})
        self.assertEqual(common.read(dest), {"first": True})

    def test_complete_checkpoint_pin(self):
        observed = common.read(common.PACKAGE / "preparation-status.json")
        required = [
            "adoption",
            "gates",
            "preservation",
            "tested_inputs",
            "page_qa",
            "visual_observation",
            "root_assessment",
        ]
        cfg = {
            "root": str(common.ROOT),
            "base": common.BASE,
            "target_sha256": common.TARGET_SHA,
            **{key: common.bind(self.original) for key in required},
        }
        cfg["adoption"] = observed["actual_adoption"]
        cfg["tested_inputs"] = observed["actual_tested_inputs"]
        accepted = self.root / "accepted-config.json"
        common.write(accepted, cfg)
        self.assertEqual(common.input_config(accepted), cfg)
        cfg["tested_inputs"] = common.bind(self.original)
        rejected = self.root / "substituted-checkpoint.json"
        common.write(rejected, cfg)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            common.input_config(rejected)

    def test_projection_requires_scope_and_original(self):
        required = [
            "adoption",
            "gates",
            "preservation",
            "tested_inputs",
            "page_qa",
            "visual_observation",
            "root_assessment",
        ]
        cfg = {
            "root": str(common.ROOT),
            "base": common.BASE,
            "target_sha256": common.TARGET_SHA,
            **{key: common.bind(self.original) for key in required},
        }
        observed = common.read(common.PACKAGE / "preparation-status.json")
        cfg["adoption"] = observed["actual_adoption"]
        cfg["tested_inputs"] = observed["actual_tested_inputs"]
        projection = self.root / "projection.json"
        common.write(projection, {"status": "explicit projection fixture"})
        cfg["additional_artifacts"] = [
            {
                "name": "projection.json",
                "original": common.bind(projection),
                "mode": "credential_header_projection",
            }
        ]
        path = self.root / "config.json"
        common.write(path, cfg)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            common.input_config(path)

    def test_script_cannot_be_plain_archive(self):
        required = [
            "adoption",
            "gates",
            "preservation",
            "tested_inputs",
            "page_qa",
            "visual_observation",
            "root_assessment",
        ]
        script = self.root / "example.py"
        script.write_text("pass\n\n")
        cfg = {
            "root": str(common.ROOT),
            "base": common.BASE,
            "target_sha256": common.TARGET_SHA,
            **{key: common.bind(self.original) for key in required},
            "additional_artifacts": [
                {"name": "script.py", "original": common.bind(script), "mode": "exact"}
            ],
        }
        observed = common.read(common.PACKAGE / "preparation-status.json")
        cfg["adoption"] = observed["actual_adoption"]
        cfg["tested_inputs"] = observed["actual_tested_inputs"]
        path = self.root / "config.json"
        common.write(path, cfg)
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            common.input_config(path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
